scope: First launch of the second H3 multitask window with recursive continuation
summary: A pre-diffusion audit found that control-video reference assembly replaced the per-action continuation image instead of appending the motion video. All three runs were stopped at 0/20, recorded as failed, and restarted in new directories after a tested fix.
evidence: All three immutable metadata files record SIGTERM failure from the deliberate early stop.
The affected jobs had loaded models but remained at diffusion step 0/20, so no candidate output was created.
A regression test now requires reference order robot image, scene image, continuation image, control video.
lessons: Metadata declaring a continuation input is not enough; the actual model reference list must be tested when multiple conditioning branches compose.
limitations: These stopped runs contain no video and are not eligible for stitching.
next_actions: Run the corrected append-only reference composition in new second-window experiment directories.
